items.summary: Lee's site says he supports more Cantonese sections, more Cantonese faculty, and work toward a state-funded Cantonese language certificate.
items.title: Add Cantonese sections and faculty

citations.quote: Jeremy supports adding more Cantonese class sections, hiring additional Cantonese faculty, and working with faculty and college leadership toward a state-funded Cantonese language certificate program.

items.summary: Lee's site says he supports expanding high-demand sections, the noncredit-to-credit pipeline, and certificate and career-education pathways.
items.title: Expand sections where student demand is strongest

citations.quote: Jeremy supports expanding sections where student demand is strongest, strengthening the pipeline from noncredit to credit programs, and growing certificate and career-education pathways.

items.summary: Lee's questionnaire says investing reserves in more classes and faculty is needed to grow enrollment.
items.title: Invest reserves in classes and faculty

citations.quote: Investing reserves now into more classes and faculty is necessary to grow enrollment.

items.summary: Lee's questionnaire says that as trustee he will oppose further consolidation to Ocean Campus.
items.title: Oppose further consolidation to Ocean Campus

citations.quote: As trustee, I will oppose further consolidation to Ocean Campus.
